course.name: CFA Level I
course.description: Illustrative sample structure for CFA Level I. This is NOT the full official curriculum — it's a representative subset (5 subjects, 2 readings each, 3 LOS each) so the app has real data to work with immediately. Import the complete, current curriculum via Courses > Import CSV.

topics.name: Code of Ethics and Standards of Professional Conduct

los.title: Describe the structure of the CFA Institute Code and Standards
Distinguish ethical conduct from merely legal conduct in investment practice
Apply the Standards to realistic workplace scenarios
Explain the objectives and scope of GIPS
Describe the requirements for a compliant performance presentation
Identify common GIPS compliance pitfalls
Calculate the future and present value of a single cash flow
Calculate the future and present value of an annuity
Solve time value problems for uneven cash flow series

topics.name: Statistical Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion

los.title: Calculate and interpret measures of central tendency
Calculate and interpret measures of dispersion
Distinguish between population and sample statistics
Describe the law of demand and the law of supply
Explain the effects of shifts in demand and supply curves
Calculate and interpret price elasticity of demand

topics.name: Aggregate Output, Prices, and Economic Growth

los.title: Explain the components of GDP from both expenditure and income approaches
Compare the sources of economic growth across economies
Explain the relationship between inflation and economic output
Describe the components of the income statement
Distinguish between revenue recognition methods
Analyze the effect of non-recurring items on reported earnings
Describe the components of the balance sheet
Evaluate liquidity and solvency using balance sheet ratios
Analyze off-balance-sheet items and their effect on reported ratios
Describe the basic features of a fixed-income security
Describe contingency provisions affecting bond cash flows
Identify common issuers of fixed-income securities
Calculate and interpret Macaulay and modified duration
Explain how convexity affects the price-yield relationship
Evaluate the effect of credit spread changes on bond prices
